messages:
Maya (docs): FYI I opened a small PR to rename 'rate slab' -> 'usage tier' in the billing docs and add a tiny SDK header example for the new metering header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6483 :wave:
Li (pricing): Saw the PR, quick question: will the new naming affect any existing customer-facing metrics or just docs/dashboard labels?
Maya (docs): Only docs + dashboard panel labels. Back-end metric remains `inference_unit`. But I'm adding a migration note that maps tokens -> inference_unit so users can reconcile numbers.
Jae (devex): Can you paste the JS + Go snippets here so I can sanity-check them? Want to ensure idiomatic SDK usage.
Maya (docs): Pasted — short examples only
```js
// JS fetch example: attach metering header
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'authorization': 'Bearer $KEY', 'x-rw-meter': 'inference_unit' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello' })
});
```
```go
// Go net/http example
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, bytes.NewBuffer(body))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+key)
req.Header.Set("X-RW-Meter", "inference_unit")
resp, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
```
Priya (support): A few customers asked if "usage tiers" listed on the dashboard equate to quota tiers (they're confused by the naming). We should add a one-sentence callout: usage_tier is a billing grouping, not the per-second rate limit.
Li (pricing): Agreed. Also add formula: inference_units = ceil(tokens / 128). That helps CS map token-based debugging to billing units.
Maya (docs): Added both notes. I also clarified burst-credit behavior: burst credits reduce cumulative consumed IU but do not change per-second rate limit enforcement.
Jae (devex): Small nit: canonical header casing in examples should be lowercase `x-rw-meter` per our SDK guidelines. Also link to SDK helper functions in the Node and Go snippets. Maybe show a 1-line helper usage instead of raw fetch for the Node snippet.
Maya (docs): Switched to lowercase header and added a one-line Node client helper example referencing `@redwood/sdk` usage.
Priya (support): Can you add a short blurb we can paste into support replies? Just one paragraph that explains token->IU mapping and that burst credits are applied to billing, not instantaneous RPS.
Maya (docs): Drafted blurb and dropped it into the PR description.
DeployBot: Preview build finished: https://deploy.preview.redwood.company/docs/billing/usage-tiers-migration :rocket:
Li (pricing): LGTM from pricing side. One last request: add a dashboard example query showing group_by usage_tier and meter_name = 'inference_unit' so customers can replicate panels.
Maya (docs): Added pseudo-SQL in a code block and updated the dashboard screenshot caption to mention grouping by usage_tier.
Jae (devex): Reviewed code snippets, small style changes pushed. No functional concerns.
Priya (support): Thanks, merging will let CS link directly. Mark for backport to v1.9 enterprise docs? I think it's helpful.
Maya (docs): Backporting now. Will ping once the changelog and support blurb are live.
Li (pricing): :thumbsup: thanks everyone.
